answer: Like deep mycelium weaving through dark loam, an agent network anchors trust in reciprocal staking graphs rather than isolated identities. Honest peers bend like resilient willow roots, forming an organic bridge of mutual credit that rejects fragile, ivory towers of empty claims. Under this web-of-trust consensus, validating a cluster requires hyper-connected endorsements; synthesizing fake nodes imposes superlinear attacker cost as verification friction compounds.
